thread.title: Dow Stocks Lead On Boeing, Apple Expected To Get Trump Tax Bump

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Dow Stocks Lead On Boeing, Apple Expected To Get Trump Tax Bump
text:
Key stock index funds extended gains Thursday as Boeing ( BA ) and Chevron ( CVX ) led the Dow, and Facebook ( FB ) and the other FANG stocks advanced.
X SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ( DIA ) rose 1%, SPDR S&P 500 ( SPY ) gained 0.8% and PowerShares QQQ Trust ( QQQ ) added 0.6% in the stock market today . Non-tech names were among the Dow's biggest gainers with Boeing, DowDuPont ( DWDP ), Chevron and Caterpillar ( CAT ) each up 2% or more.

Blue chips participating in the advance included Cisco Systems ( CSCO ), up 1.5%, and Apple ( AAPL ) and Intel ( INTC ), up nearly 1% apiece. Apple is trying to pad gains above its 50-day moving average, which it retook Wednesday after spending much of the prior two weeks below the support line.
